title: Api health
description: The body of GET /api/health. The route answers 503 with the same body when a database or a broker connection is down, so a container healthcheck can read the status code and an operator can read the reason. It never carries a credential or a connection string.

link_state.title: Link state
link_state.description: Whether one connection of the backend is usable right now.

heartbeat_state.title: Heartbeat state
heartbeat_state.description: State of one watchdog: answering, silent past its timeout, or not yet known.

status.description: ok when every connection is up, degraded otherwise.

version.description: Version of the backend image or package that answered.

backend.description: Which decision backend is selected and which model it calls.

model.description: Model identifier of the selected decision backend.

mqtt.description: The two broker connections: the diagnosis client and the ops client.

db.description: The two database roles: the application schema and the read-only ground-truth schema.

heartbeats.description: The two watchdogs of the backend, in the state they are in right now.

sim.description: Where the replay stands, null before the first retained simulator status arrives.

oneOf.title: Health sim
oneOf.description: The three replay values the health route repeats from the retained simulator status.

counters.description: Free-form process counters for debugging; consumers read the keys they know and ignore the rest.

uptime_s.description: Seconds since the backend process started.
